ValidationRule.description:
A pending row with no approver is invisible to everyone and can never be decided — it just sits there looking submitted.
★R9 The rule guards Approver_1__c, and only that one, on purpose. Levels 2 and above are legitimately blank: a chain that ends at the Account Owner because they are a Regional Head is a complete chain, not a broken one, and requiring the upper levels would forbid exactly the case requirement.md asks for. Level 1 is different — it is the level the approval process enters at, and a Pending row without it would be approved by the step's fail-closed branch or sit for ever, depending on which way that branch is set.
The rule also has a second job now. ApprovalChainService refuses to resolve an unroutable batch, so in practice this state is unreachable through the UI; keeping the constraint at the database is what makes that a guarantee rather than a habit of one Apex class.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This invitee cannot be submitted: no approval chain could be determined. It needs an Account Owner — which comes from the attendee's Contact link — and that owner needs a Manager if the chain is to go any higher.
